title: Mechanical & Advancement Definition Authoring

selection_basis.reduced_strict_order: MRCS-04 → MRCS-05 → MRCS-08 → MRCS-11 → MRCS-12 → MRCS-13 → MRCS-14 → MRCS-16 → MRCS-17 → MRCS-19 → MRCS-21
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MSAS-07 remains selected_not_started; MVPS-14 remains selected_not_started.

objective: Author governed mechanical and advancement definitions for Actions, Effects, Conditions, Resources, durations/triggers, Abilities/trees/prestige/prerequisites, Attributes, Skills, Knowledges, Proficiencies and advancement packages while preserving CAB economics and owner-domain semantics.
acceptance: Attribute/Skill/Knowledge/Proficiency packages preserve owner advancement economics
stacking/interaction stays definition-driven rather than universal
boundaries: MRCS-01, MRCS-03 and MRCS-04 remain the workspace, guided-authoring and bounded-expression foundations consumed by this tranche.
Action, Event, Effect, Condition and Resource owner contracts retain semantic and runtime authority; MRCS authors definitions and references only.
CAB remains completed advancement/balance authority; MRCS cannot redefine prerequisite economics, tier economics, XP/training costs or prestige eligibility outside CAB-owned rules.
Attributes, Skills, Knowledges and Proficiencies retain owner advancement semantics and economics; packages may reference but not replace those owners.
Stacking, interaction, duration and trigger behavior must be explicit definition data or owner references rather than a new universal MRCS rule.
Preview and validation remain noncanonical and cannot execute live Actions/Events or mutate Character/runtime state.
MRCS-08+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MSAS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
next_action: On an MRCS-specific owner Continue, fresh-read the MRCS-05 dependency closure and mrcs lane-state ref, then start and execute the bounded tranche under OPS3-11 milestone-only execution.
